atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
rangeLen = input(20, "Range Coil Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
rankLen = input(100, "Coil Ranking Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
expLen = input(5, "Expansion Lookback", 2, 20, 1)
relThresh = input(15, "Release ATR Percentile Threshold", 5, 40, 1)
vovRiseBars = input(5, "VoV Rise Bars", 1, 20, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
rangeLow = lowest(rng, rangeLen)
rangeHigh = highest(rng, rangeLen)
rangeCoil = rangeLow / max(rangeHigh, 0.000000001)

countBelow = 0.0
j = 1
while j <= rankLen {
  if atrVal[j] < atrVal {
    countBelow = countBelow + 1
  }
  j = j + 1
}
pct = countBelow / max(rankLen, 1)
coilLoad = 100 * (1 - pct)

atrSd = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
atrMed = median(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = atrSd / max(atrMed, 0.000000001)
vovScaled = vov * 100
vovOld = vov[vovRiseBars]
vovRising = vov > vovOld

sumAbs = 0.0
p = 0
while p < predLen {
  sumAbs = sumAbs + abs(close[p] - close[p + 1])
  p = p + 1
}
pastC = close[predLen]
moveAmt = abs(close - pastC)
eff = moveAmt / max(sumAbs, 0.000000001)
predict = 100 * eff

priorHigh = highest(high[1], expLen)
priorLow = lowest(low[1], expLen)
priorRangeHigh = highest(rng[1], expLen)
expansionUp = rng > priorRangeHigh and close > priorHigh
expansionDn = rng > priorRangeHigh and close < priorLow

loadThresh = 100 - relThresh
loaded = coilLoad > loadThresh and rangeCoil < 0.5 and vovRising
releaseUp = loaded[1] and expansionUp
releaseDn = loaded[1] and expansionDn
buySig = loaded and releaseUp
sellSig = loaded and releaseDn
predHigh = predict >= 50
buyPredictable = buySig and predHigh
buyUnpredictable = buySig and not predHigh
sellPredictable = sellSig and predHigh
sellUnpredictable = sellSig and not predHigh

if buyPredictable { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Up", "triangleup", "#00e5ff") }
if buyUnpredictable { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Up", "triangleup", "#888888") }
if sellPredictable { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Dn", "triangledown", "#ff8800") }
if sellUnpredictable { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Dn", "triangledown", "#888888") }
if buyPredictable { plotshape_3d(bar_index, predict, "Release Up", "coneup", "#00e5ff", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if buyUnpredictable { plotshape_3d(bar_index, predict, "Release Up", "coneup", "#ff33cc", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellPredictable { plotshape_3d(bar_index, predict, "Release Dn", "conedown", "#ff8800", markerSize, 1, "separate") }
if sellUnpredictable { plotshape_3d(bar_index, predict, "Release Dn", "conedown", "#888888", markerSize, 1, "separate") }
if buyPredictable { label3d(bar_index, predict, "Release", "#00e5ff", 1, 1, "separate") }
if sellPredictable { label3d(bar_index, predict, "Release", "#ff8800", 1, 1, "separate") }

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22cc88", 2, "separate")
plot(predict, "Predictability", "#ffaa00", 2, "separate")
plot(atrVal, "ATR", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "scatter", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predict, "Predictability 3D", "trail", "#00e5ff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(vovScaled, "VoV 3D", "bars3d", "#ff33cc", "separate", 2)

// Multi-Timeframe Siege Model
// Session range extremes + confirmed 1h structure + model.* execution

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length (bars)", 5, 200, 1)
confLook = input(3, "1h Confirmation Lookback (bars)", 1, 20, 1)
buffTicks = input(2, "Structure Break Buffer (ticks)", 0, 50, 1)
stopDist = input(10.0, "Hard Stop Distance (price)", 0.5, 100.0, 0.5)
minQ = input(60, "Min Structure Quality for Entry", 0, 100, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
upperExt = sessHigh
lowerExt = sessLow
mid = (sessHigh + sessLow) / 2

buffer = buffTicks * 1.0

htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfClose = security("1h", close)

priorHtfHigh = htfHigh[1]
priorHtfLow = htfLow[1]

bullBreak = htfClose > priorHtfHigh + buffer
bearBreak = htfClose < priorHtfLow - buffer

isBull = bullBreak
isBear = bearBreak

bullRecent = bullBreak
bearRecent = bearBreak
for i = 1 to 20 {
    inRange = i < confLook
    pastBull = bullBreak[i]
    pastBear = bearBreak[i]
    if inRange {
        bullRecent = bullRecent or pastBull
        bearRecent = bearRecent or pastBear
    }
}

htfBeyondBull = htfClose > priorHtfHigh
htfBeyondBear = htfClose < priorHtfLow
chartBeyondBull = close > upperExt
chartBeyondBear = close < lowerExt

confLong = (bullRecent ? 50 : 0) + (htfBeyondBull ? 25 : 0) + (chartBeyondBull ? 25 : 0)
confShort = (bearRecent ? 50 : 0) + (htfBeyondBear ? 25 : 0) + (chartBeyondBear ? 25 : 0)

var longOpen = false
var longStop = 0.0
var shortOpen = false
var shortStop = 0.0

buySig = close > upperExt[1] and isBull and confLong >= minQ
sellSig = close < lowerExt[1] and isBear and confShort >= minQ
exitLong = close < mid or isBear
exitShort = close > mid or isBull

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confLong / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.longEntry("SiegeLong")
    longOpen := true
    longStop := close - stopDist
    shortOpen := false
    shortStop := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}

if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confShort / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("SiegeShort")
    shortOpen := true
    shortStop := close + stopDist
    longOpen := false
    longStop := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

if exitLong and longOpen {
    model.longExit("SiegeLong")
    longOpen := false
    longStop := 0.0
    line.delete("siegeStop")
}

if exitShort and shortOpen {
    model.shortExit("SiegeShort")
    shortOpen := false
    shortStop := 0.0
    line.delete("siegeStop")
}

if longOpen {
    line.new(bar_index - 1, longStop, bar_index, longStop, "#ff4477", 1, "solid", false, "siegeStop")
}

if shortOpen {
    line.new(bar_index - 1, shortStop, bar_index, shortStop, "#ff4477", 1, "solid", false, "siegeStop")
}

plot(upperExt, "UpperExtreme", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(lowerExt, "LowerExtreme", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(mid, "Mid", "#cccccc", 1, "stepline")
